name: Where Fish Swim and Waters Sing
description:
A seashell-shaped fish tank inspired by a certain soprano from the Korolevskiy Troupe, featuring an exquisite and distinctive design.
Taking inspiration from the legendary resting places of Water Imps, its creator designed and crafted this fish tank using a unique technique. Simply by approaching it, one can watch the fish swimming freely within.
After a certain Water Imp caught sight of this fish tank, she insisted on having a Water Imp doll custom-made that could fit inside. However, due to issues with manufacturing precision and material selection, the doll has yet to officially take the plunge.
Until then, the little fish will have the place all to themselves.
